issue_context.title: Make Style/RedundantReturn aware of dynamic methods
issue_context.body:
Potential enhancement to `Style/RedundantReturn`.

Currently, `Style/RedundantReturn` only examines statically-defined methods, and skips those defined via `define_method()`:

```ruby
def foo
  return 42   # Style/RedundantReturn flags redundant return ✔️
end

define_method(:bar) do
  return 42   # Style/RedundantReturn ignores 😔
end
```

It _seems_ like it could support both (but maybe I'm missing something)

review_comments:
The following will resolve some false negatives and reduce code.

```diff
--- a/lib/rubocop/cop/style/redundant_return.rb
+++ b/lib/rubocop/cop/style/redundant_return.rb
@@ -53,18 +53,12 @@ module RuboCop

         MSG = 'Redundant `return` detected.'
         MULTI_RETURN_MSG = 'To return multiple values, use an array.'
-        DYNAMIC_DEFINE_METHODS = %i[define_method define_singleton_method].to_set.freeze
-        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = DYNAMIC_DEFINE_METHODS
-
-        # @!method method_definition(node)
-        def_node_matcher :method_definition, <<~PATTERN
-          (block (send _ %DYNAMIC_DEFINE_METHODS _) _ $(begin ...))
-        PATTERN
+        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[define_method define_singleton_method].freeze

         def on_send(node)
-          method_definition(node.parent) do |def_node|
-            check_branch(def_node)
-          end
+          return unless (parent = node.parent) && parent.block_type?
+
+          check_branch(parent.body)
         end

         def on_def(node)
```
It certainly looks better that way. Thank you very much. I updated this PR.

The following false negative and autocorrection should be resolved.

```ruby
    expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
      define_method(:foo) do
        return something
        ^^^^^^ Redundant `return` detected.
      end
    RUBY
```
Thank you very much. I updated this PR.
